questions.question: In which 1990 Christmas comedy is a boy accidentally left behind when his family flies to Paris?
questions.note: Macaulay Culkin as Kevin McCallister; the Wet Bandits never recover.

questions.question: Which 1991 thriller pairs Jodie Foster’s FBI trainee with Anthony Hopkins as Hannibal Lecter?
questions.note: It swept the “Big Five” Oscars — Picture, Director, Actor, Actress, Screenplay.

questions.question: What 1993 Steven Spielberg film opens a dinosaur theme park that goes very wrong?
questions.note: Based on Michael Crichton’s novel; “life finds a way.”

questions.question: Which 1994 prison drama, based on a Stephen King novella, follows Andy Dufresne at Shawshank?
questions.note: A slow starter at the box office; now a perennial “best film ever” poll champ.

questions.question: Which 1994 Quentin Tarantino film is told out of order and follows hitmen Vincent and Jules?
choices: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
questions.note: John Travolta’s comeback; the dance at Jack Rabbit Slim’s.

questions.question: Which 1994 Tom Hanks film follows an Alabama man through decades of U.S. history?
questions.note: It beat Pulp Fiction and The Shawshank Redemption to Best Picture.

questions.question: Which 1997 disaster romance about a sinking ocean liner starred Leonardo DiCaprio and Kate Winslet?
questions.note: James Cameron; “I’m the king of the world!”

questions.question: Which 1999 sci-fi film asks Neo to choose between a red pill and a blue pill?
questions.note: Keanu Reeves, Carrie-Anne Moss, and a lot of black leather.

questions.question: Which 2000 Ridley Scott epic stars Russell Crowe as a Roman general sold into slavery?
questions.note: “Are you not entertained?” — and a Best Picture winner.

questions.question: Which 2001 film began Peter Jackson’s Lord of the Rings trilogy?
questions.note: Nine walkers leave Rivendell; the trilogy wraps in 2003.
